package.name: juqiao_glove
package.description: ROS 2 driver and RViz visualization for the Juqiao Industrial (矩侨工业) fabric tactile glove (JQGY-YL-11 / JQGY-YL-31). Reads the wired-USB or wireless-Bluetooth-receiver serial stream at 921600 baud, publishes a 256-element pressure array (uint8 and Newtons), and an IMU orientation quaternion from the on-glove ICM-42688.
